items.headline: ALB vs. SQM: Which Lithium Stock Should You Bet on Now?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation ALB and Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile S.A. SQM are prominent players in the lithium space. Both companies are well-positioned to gain from robust long-term growth in lithium demand from electric vehicles (EVs) and energy storage systems.

items.headline: Lithium price 'chill' returns, JPMorgan downgrades Albemarle (ALB.US) earnings forecast and cuts target price to $140
items.snippet: Albemarle's Greenbushes CGP3 plant in Australia continues to face delays after a fire in June. JPMorgan believes that Albemarle's current stock price is close to its target price, and the valuation is reasonable for a high-quality but volatile lithium producer.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation: Q2 2026 Earnings Calls on Aug 06, 2026 - Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand is up 45% through May, primarily driven by continued strength in stationary storage. We are increasing our 2026 and 2030 stationary storage forecast ranges due to that strong demand.

items.headline: ALBEMARLE CORP files FORM 10-Q for Q2, FY 2026 on Aug 5, 2026
items.snippet: Global demand for lithium battery and energy storage, particularly for electric vehicles and energy storage systems, will continue to grow, providing the opportunity to continue to develop high quality and innovative products while managing the high cost of expanding capacity.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation - Albemarle Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: Energy Storage production volumes are expected to increase year over year. Sales volumes are expected to be in the range of 225 to 235 kilotons lithium carbonate equivalent, as increased Wodgina volumes partially offset a delay in the Talison CGP3 ramp due to a fire that occurred
